title: Continuity of higher-order derivatives for integrated density of states of the discrete Anderson model with respect to the disorder parameter
summary: We derive quantitative continuity estimates for the higher-order derivatives of the integrated density of states (IDS) with respect to the disorder parameter for the Anderson model on $\ell^2(\mathbb{G})$. Here $\mathbb{G}=\mathbb{Z}^d$ or $\mathbb{B}$, where $\mathbb{B}$ denotes the Bethe lattice. Our results hold in the regime of strong disorder, where entire spectrum is localized. We assume sufficient smoothness of the density of the single site distribution so that the IDS admits higher-order derivatives.
